description: This file contains the implementation of a PDF processing pipeline that detects logos, overlays new logos, and generates a replaced PDF. It includes functions for rasterizing PDFs, detecting logos with template matching, overlaying images on PDF pages, and managing jobs and their statuses. The core classes and functions handle job creation, status updates, preview generation, and final output delivery.

classes.name: PdfLogoReplaceManager
classes.description: Coordinator class for managing PDF logo replacement jobs, including creation, progress tracking, preview retrieval, confirmation, and download.

methods.name: str create_job_and_start(pdf_file, old_logo_files, new_logo_file, params: StartRequestParams)

methods.name: Optional[StatusResponse] get_status(job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves current status and findings of a given job, merging in-memory and on-disk metadata.

methods.name: Optional[bytes] get_preview(job_id: str, page_index: int, preview_type: str)
methods.description: Retrieves PNG preview images for detected logos or replaced overlays for a specific page and job.

methods.name: bool confirm(job_id: str)
methods.description: Marks a completed job as confirmed, updating metadata accordingly.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[str,bytes]] get_download(job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the filename and bytes of the resulting replaced PDF for download.

methods.name: list[str] get_all_output_pdfs(job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of all PDFs generated for a specific job, supporting future multiple outputs.
